definitions.explanation: An introductory-level resource or course for learning something new. Commonly used in book titles and course names.

definitions.gloss: becoming a disciple, entering a school
definitions.explanation: Formally becoming a student or disciple under a master, especially in traditional arts, martial arts, or crafts.

examples.japanese: プログラミング{入門|にゅうもん}の{本|ほん}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought an introductory book on programming.

examples.japanese: この{講座|こうざ}は{初心者|しょしんしゃ}{向|む}けの{入門|にゅうもん}コースです。
examples.english: This class is a beginner-level introductory course.

examples.japanese: {日本語|にほんご}{入門|にゅうもん}のテキストとしては、これが{一番|いちばん}わかりやすい。
examples.english: As an introductory Japanese textbook, this one is the easiest to understand.

examples.japanese: {師匠|ししょう}に{入門|にゅうもん}する。
examples.english: Become a disciple of a master.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}、{茶道|さどう}の{先生|せんせい}に{入門|にゅうもん}した。
examples.english: When I was young, I entered the school of a tea ceremony teacher.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}な{落語家|らくごか}に{入門|にゅうもん}して、{弟子|でし}として{修行|しゅぎょう}を{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: I became a disciple of a famous rakugo performer and began my training.

notes:
Sense 1 is by far the more common usage in modern Japanese, appearing frequently in book titles and course names.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・〜{入門|にゅうもん} (introduction to ~, as a book/course title suffix)
・{入門|にゅうもん}{書|しょ} (introductory book)
・{入門|にゅうもん}コース (introductory course)
・{入門|にゅうもん}{編|へん} (introductory volume/section)
・{師匠|ししょう}に{入門|にゅうもん}する (become a master's disciple)

Sense 2 is used in traditional arts such as {落語|らくご} (comic storytelling), {茶道|さどう} (tea ceremony), {書道|しょどう} (calligraphy), and {武道|ぶどう} (martial arts).
